title.zh-TW: 模型清單與提示現在會即時正確顯示
title.en: Model lists and notes now update accurately in real time

body.zh-TW:
切換或查看可用模型，畫面上的清單和附註現在都跟得上最新狀態。

只要目前這個工作階段的模型清單有變，已經打開的 `/model` 與 `/context-window` 下拉選單，裡面的選項列和標記就會立刻更新。

你帳號裡可用的模型變動，或是從別的用戶端切換了模型，模型選擇器的清單也會即時刷新。

API 金鑰（連接外部服務的驗證密碼）的模型說明，現在只會出現在你實際看到的第一份清單，不會在彈出視窗底下又冒出來。
body.en:
When you switch or view available models, the on-screen lists and notes now stay up to date.

Open `/model` and `/context-window` dropdowns now update their rows and markers immediately whenever the current session's model list changes.

When the available models on your account change, or another client switches the model, the model picker updates its list live.

The model note for an API key (an authentication credential for external services) now appears only in the first list you actually see, and will not reappear underneath modals.

items.original:
Open `/model` and `/context-window` dropdowns now update their rows and markers immediately when the session's model list changes
Model picker now updates its list live when your account models change or another client switches the model
API-key model note now appears only in the first list the user actually sees and does not reappear under modals

title.zh-TW: grok update 從別份執行會提示後續做法
title.en: grok update explains next steps when run from another copy

body.zh-TW: 在終端機跑 `grok update` 準備升級版本，卻不確定有沒有動到原本在用的那一份嗎？現在只要它發現自己是從另一份副本執行，就會主動說明這個狀況，並告訴你接下來該怎麼做。⟦去連鎖門市辦會員續約時，以前不小心走到另一家分店櫃檯也不會特別提醒，現在對方會先點出你跑錯分館，再告訴你下一步怎麼辦。⟧
body.en: Running `grok update` in your terminal to upgrade, but unsure whether it touched the copy you normally use? Now, whenever it detects that it ran from a different copy, it explains what happened and tells you what to do next. ⟦Picture renewing a membership at a chain store: before, if you walked up to the wrong branch counter, nobody flagged it; now the clerk points out you are at a different branch and walks you through what to do next.⟧

items.original: `grok update` now explains when it ran from a different copy and what to do next

title.zh-TW: 打字與送出提問不會再閃退或誤取消
title.en: Typing and sending prompts no longer crash or misfire

body.zh-TW:
在輸入框打字、按鍵送出或排隊追問，這幾個中斷對話的問題都修好了。

切換到多行模式輸入內容，如果那一行剛好以反斜線「\」結尾，現在按 `Shift+Enter` 或 `Alt+Enter` 都能正常送出。

使用 Send-now 立即送出或連按兩次 `Enter`，第一下剛啟動的這一輪對話不會再被第二下取消。

視窗高度比較矮的終端機裡，輸入很長的回答也不會再突然閃退。

遇到權限詢問而選擇拒絕或取消後，原本已經排在後面等著送出的追問不會再平白消失。

在 Apple Terminal 的精簡模式連按兩次 `Ctrl+O`，也不會把剛剛送出去的提示取消掉。
body.en:
Several issues that interrupted conversations while typing in the input box, pressing keys to send, or queuing follow-ups are now fixed.

In multiline mode, if a line ends with a backslash "\", pressing `Shift+Enter` or `Alt+Enter` now sends it properly.

When using Send-now or pressing `Enter` twice, the second press no longer cancels the turn that the first press just started.

Typing long answers in a short terminal window no longer causes a sudden crash.

When you reject or cancel a permission prompt, follow-ups already queued behind it are no longer lost.

Double-tapping `Ctrl+O` in minimal mode on Apple Terminal no longer cancels the prompt you just sent.

items.original:
`Shift+Enter` (or `Alt+Enter`) in multiline mode now correctly sends a line that ends with a backslash
Send-now and double-Enter no longer cancel a turn that the first press just started
Typing long answers on short terminals no longer crashes
Queued follow-ups are no longer lost when a permission prompt is rejected or cancelled
Double-tapping `Ctrl+O` in minimal mode on Apple Terminal no longer cancels the just-sent prompt

title.zh-TW: 新的設定選擇不會再被舊寫入覆蓋
title.en: Newer settings picks are no longer overwritten by older writes

body.zh-TW: 剛挑好新的設定選項，過去如果遇到比較晚才寫進來的舊資料，新選項就會被蓋回去。現在這個問題已經修好，較新的設定選擇不會再被延遲的舊寫入覆蓋。⟦跟填表改通訊地址一樣，以前晚寄到的舊紙本會把你剛送出的新地址蓋掉，現在慢到的舊紀錄不會再蓋過新選擇。⟧
body.en: If you just picked a new setting and older data arrived late to write, your new pick used to get overwritten. That bug is now fixed, so a newer settings pick is no longer overwritten by a delayed older write. ⟦Think of updating your mailing address on a form: an older paper form arriving late in the mail used to overwrite the new address you just submitted, whereas now that late record no longer replaces your newer choice.⟧

items.original: A newer settings pick is no longer overwritten by a delayed older write

title.zh-TW: 中途登入按 Ctrl+N 不再多開工作階段
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+N during mid-session sign-in no longer opens an extra session

body.zh-TW: 你正在使用到一半，中途突然跳出需要重新登入的關卡。過去如果在這個畫面按了 `Ctrl+N`，等你之後完成登入，就會多開出一個額外的工作階段。現在這個問題已經修好，在途中的登入畫面按 `Ctrl+N` 不會再於登入後多開工作階段。⟦就像在銀行辦事中途被請去補驗證身分時，以前在等待畫面多按的那張號碼牌會在驗證完才跳出來多叫一號，現在不會多開一輪。⟧
body.en: Sometimes a sign-in prompt pops up mid-session asking you to sign back in. Previously, pressing `Ctrl+N` on that screen would open an extra session once you finished signing in. That is now fixed, so pressing `Ctrl+N` on a mid-session sign-in screen no longer opens an extra session after you sign in. ⟦A bank customer asked to step aside for an extra ID check used to see an extra ticket they pressed on the waiting screen call another number once verification finished, but now it no longer starts an extra round.⟧

items.original: Pressing `Ctrl+N` on a mid-session sign-in screen no longer opens an extra session after you later sign in
